method: Behavior-only change: the heart in FavoriteButton.svelte and the viewer's save control in Lightbox.svelte now ask the saved-photos store by photo.id instead of image_key; no copy, layout or style changed. Walked locally on this branch (vite dev, placeholder Supabase values, invented records using a static hero image) in the browser pane at desktop width and at 375px: the saved page with an old stored list (count 1, the orphan id dropped); importing a file holding two photos that share a frame name plus a null entry (both shown saved, 'Imported 2 saved photos.'); tapping one twin's heart removes only that photo; Undo restores it; the viewer reads 'Saved · Remove' and removes the open photo; a removal in a second tab updates the first without reload; a file with no usable photo shows 'Import Failed' and leaves the list. No horizontal scroll at 375px. Not covered: real gallery data and images, album, explore, collections and photo pages (they render the same heart), dark/light theme switch, and the production walk, which runs after this deploy.
